summary: editable-contracts ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated and, on `npm install`, downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB bundle tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs` whose contents are hidden behind a rotating numeric-array string cipher and a custom-alphabet decoder — orders of magnitude larger and structurally unrelated to the ~7KB mobx/React JSON-form-editing library the package advertises in `dist/editable-contracts.js`. The alternate-runtime path is used to execute the obfuscated bundle outside Node, evading Node-based install-time inspection. The delivery fires automatically on default `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
